related.title: GAN：生成器損失與模式覆蓋
related.titleEn: GAN: generator losses and mode coverage
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付潛變量介面、KL端點與歸約尺度表。；KL兩值與差.375正確，單位nats且variance正值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver latent contracts, KL endpoints and reduction-scale tables.; Both KLs and difference.375 match, in nats with positive variance.
related.difference: 畫z→G→D→loss，訓練G時保留通往G梯度但不更新D參數；訓練D時反過來。；兩loss正確，G/D參數更新邊界清楚，雙峰覆蓋有分組統計。
related.differenceEn: Draw z→G→D→loss; generator updates retain gradients through D without updating D parameters.; Losses match, update ownership is explicit and both modes have separate coverage statistics.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課採非飽和生成器損失Lg=−ln D(G(z))；與原始minimax目標分開標記。；教學判別器給生成樣本機率.2，改.4；自然對數。；Lg=−ln.2=1.6094379；改.4時.9162907。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Gaussian-to-standard-normal KL=.5(mu²+variance−1−ln variance), requiring positive variance.; Teaching mean.5,variance.25; change mean to1.; KL=.5(.25+.25−1−ln.25)=.44314718; changed result.81814718.

Use the nonsaturating generator loss Lg=−ln D(G(z)), explicitly distinguished from the minimax objective.; Teaching discriminator probability.2 then.4, using natural logarithms.; Lg=−ln.2=1.6094379; at.4 it is.9162907.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: LoRA：低秩更新與可訓練參數
related.titleEn: LoRA: low-rank updates and trainable parameters
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付潛變量介面、KL端點與歸約尺度表。；KL兩值與差.375正確，單位nats且variance正值。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver latent contracts, KL endpoints and reduction-scale tables.; Both KLs and difference.375 match, in nats with positive variance.
related.difference: 標A的r×din、B的dout×r與α/r縮放；列凍結及可訓練參數群組。；8192及16384正確，凍結權重不更新，合併前後差小於教學1e−6。
related.differenceEn: Label A r×din,B dout×r and alpha/r scaling; list frozen and trainable groups.; Counts match,base weights remain frozen and merge differences stay below teaching1e−6.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: W為dout×din，ΔW=BA，rank r參數量r(din+dout)；基底權重仍需儲存。；教學din=dout=512,r8；改r16，不計偏置。；P=8×(512+512)=8192；r16時16384，完整W為262144。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Gaussian-to-standard-normal KL=.5(mu²+variance−1−ln variance), requiring positive variance.; Teaching mean.5,variance.25; change mean to1.; KL=.5(.25+.25−1−ln.25)=.44314718; changed result.81814718.

For W=dout×din and deltaW=BA,rank r uses r(din+dout) parameters; base weights still occupy storage.; Teaching din=dout512,r8 then16,excluding bias.; P=8×(512+512)=8192; r16 gives16384,versus262144 for full W.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
